title: Bank ledger with fees
prompt: The input is a list of transactions applied in order to an account whose balance starts at 0. A non-negative amount is a deposit and is always added. A negative amount is a withdrawal: if the balance plus the amount is still >= 0 it is applied; otherwise it is rejected, the balance is unchanged by it, and a fee of 1 is subtracted from the balance only if the balance is >= 1 (the fee never makes the balance negative). Return pair(final balance, number of rejected withdrawals).
